about.title: About
about.statement: I build useful, solid, production-ready products, always keeping the user at the center.
description: I am a passionate and motivated computer science student, always ready to take on new challenges and keep learning. I've had the opportunity to work on a variety of projects, which has helped me develop both my technical skills and my ability to collaborate effectively, even under pressure.
I'm particularly passionate about web and software development. I love discovering new technologies, experimenting, and sharing my knowledge with others so we can grow together.
Currently a third-year student at Epitech in the Grande École Program, I'm constantly looking for opportunities to apply what I've learned and contribute to real-world projects.
